title: Spellforge Laundromat
description: A hooded figure in purple sits on a crate inside a cosmic laundromat, spray-painting a colorful t-shirt on an ironing board. Glowing clothes and t-shirts with mystical symbols hang on a line above, while washing machines filled with starry space line the metallic walls under a neon 'SPELLFORGE LAUNDROMAT - OPEN FOREVER' sign.
prompt: A hooded figure wearing a purple hoodie sits on a crate inside a futuristic laundromat that opens into outer space, using a spray can to paint a vibrant t-shirt on an ironing board with paint dripping down, clothes and graphic tees with magical symbols glowing and hanging on a line above, washing machines on both sides revealing galaxies and stars inside, checkered floor with paint splatters, neon sign reading SPELLFORGE LAUNDROMAT - OPEN FOREVER, vibrant cosmic atmosphere with purple yellow and pink hues
